implementation: Actual application Worker/auth modules, node:crypto scrypt, pg TCP connection to PostgreSQL; isolated schema; no SQLite or mock database
postgresVersion: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35228, 64-bit

checks.name: real PostgreSQL TCP connection and unique isolated schema
four independent connection pools initialize concurrently with one owner and marker
anonymous application documents and private modules are blocked
wrong and unknown-user passwords return the same generic failure
login stores a hashed session token in PostgreSQL and sets secure HttpOnly cookie
CSRF and exact Origin are required for admin mutations
owner creates ordinary account, rejects duplicate and ignores role escalation
ordinary account cannot list, create, disable, reset or escalate users
closing and reopening the real connection pool preserves accounts and active sessions
database transaction rolls back all writes on a SQL failure
expiry in PostgreSQL immediately invalidates a session
disabling revokes every session and reenabling never revives old cookies
administrator password reset rejects old password and revokes sessions
own password change requires current password and ends current sessions
logout deletes persisted session and prevents replay
real MVCC: reset waits for an in-flight locked login then revokes its inserted session
real MVCC: disable waits for an in-flight locked login then revokes its inserted session
real MVCC: login waits for an uncommitted password reset and rejects the old password
real MVCC: login waits for an uncommitted disable and rejects the disabled account
concurrent password attempts across pools obey persistent atomic account limit
bootstrap marker survives reconnect and does not resurrect deleted accounts
closed actual PostgreSQL pool fails closed for every private surface
